metas.name: Dumb Patrol
metas.description: Biplane battles over France in World War I between Bugs and Baron (Yosemite) Sam Von Shamm.

metas.name: Hawaiian Aye Aye
metas.description: Tweety Bird is on vacation with his mistress, Granny, in Hawaii, where Sylvester Cat is scrounging for food on a beach...

metas.name: Señorella and the Glass Huarache
metas.description: In a Mexican restaurant, a man named Jose tells to his friend, Manuel, the story of Senorella, a Mexican version of Cinderella. metas.description: Corn on the Cop is a 1965 Merrie Melodies short directed by Irv Spector and starring Daffy Duck and Porky Pig. metas.name: Run, Run, Sweet Road Runner
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote unsuccessfully tries to catch the Road Runner in a bird seed trap with overhead spikes.

metas.name: Tired and Feathered
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote's latest misbegotten Road Runner-catching schemes include a propeller-powered backpack...

metas.name: Boulder Wham!
metas.description: The Coyote tries, with no success, to find a way across a gorge to reach the Road Runner on the other side.

metas.name: Just Plane Beep
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote builds a World War I bi-plane to chase the Road Runner.

metas.name: Hairied and Hurried
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote chases the Road Runner and hopes, without success, to catch his prey using such schemes as a snow-making machine.

metas.name: Highway Runnery
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote chases the Road Runner around an old jalopy that starts up and runs him over, with the Road Runner at the wheel.

metas.name: Chaser on the Rocks
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote is both thirsty and hungry in this one. He keeps seeing mirages of oases in the desert as he chases the Road Runner.

metas.name: Shot and Bothered
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote uses suction cups, a tennis net, TNT sticks on a rope, a skateboard, helium gas, and a bomb in his unsuccessful attempts to catch the Road Runner.

metas.name: Out and Out Rout
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote chases the Road Runner using a skateboard, a hunting falcon, two doves tied to his feet.

metas.name: The Solid Tin Coyote
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote uses scrap metal from a dump to build a huge mechanical robot in his own image and uses it to chase the Road Runner.

metas.name: Clippety Clobbered
metas.description: Wile E. Coyote uses a chemistry set to try and catch the Road Runner. He mixes chemicals to yield invisible paint...

metas.name: Quacker Tracker
metas.description: The Tooth & Nail Hunting Society is offering a reward to anyone who can bag their only missing trophy, Speedy Gonzales. Daffy's just the fool to do it. metas.name: The Music Mice-Tro
metas.description: Daffy Duck falls victim to being tormented by Speedy Gonzales and two other mice who form a band and wants to put a stop to it.

metas.name: The Spy Swatter
metas.description: After a mouse scientist invents a cheese than can strengthen mice to defeat cats, Daffy Duck is ordered to stop Speedy Gonzales before he can deliver the formula.
